changelog:
Initial release of the Cluster Gateway Node Skill.

- Manages the OpenClaw Gateway as the central hub for sub-agent communication, task distribution, and cluster coordination
- Provides CLI commands for status checks, sub-agent deployment, task dispatching, and relay node configuration
- Includes cluster architecture diagram and node role definitions (gateway, worker, relay, storage)
- Offers a sample configuration file and outlines current blockers (e.g., pending messaging interface)
summary: Verwaltet das OpenClaw Cluster Gateway als zentralen Hub zur Koordination, Task-Verteilung und Kommunikation zwischen Sub-Agenten im Cluster.
